lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters arranged in a regular quasi-rectangular grid of 5 horizontal rows and approximately 12 vertical columns posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are clearly visible, intersecting with horizontal rows to form a lattice-like pattern of anchor nodes across the primary lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature extending from the upper branchial region towards the posterior, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance transition with highlight on the dorsal edge and shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of approximately 6-8 distinct high-intensity blobs located within the posterior half of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small, discrete reddish-orange pigmented lesions (possible ectoparasites) are visible: one anterior to the gill slits, one situated between the fourth and fifth gill slits, and one on the lower lateral flank posterior to the pectoral fin base.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density gradient of smaller, tightly clustered high-luminance spots that contrast with the larger, more dispersed blobs of the main lateral flank.
